title: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Autopilot & Enterprise Clusters — D5
purpose: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
routing_rationale: GKE separates control plane orchestration from data-plane execution. In Autopilot clusters, Google manages worker node provisioning, OS security, and auto-upgrades.

nodes.label: K8s API Server
nodes.detail: Managed master endpoint validating declarative manifests and RBAC.

nodes.label: etcd Consensus Store
nodes.detail: Replicated state store recording cluster specs, leases, and pod bindings.

nodes.label: GKE Worker Node
nodes.detail: Host VM running containerd runtime and kubelet daemon.

nodes.label: Application Pod
nodes.detail: Container with direct IP routable across VPC via Alias IP / Andromeda.

nodes.label: Standalone NEG
nodes.detail: Directly registers Pod IPs with Cloud Load Balancer, bypassing kube-proxy iptables.

steps.title: Manifest Commit
steps.action: Deployment controller submits pod spec; API server writes state to etcd.
steps.why_traversal: Raft consensus guarantees cluster state durability across control plane replicas.

steps.title: Kubelet Scheduling
steps.action: kube-scheduler binds pod to node; kubelet invokes containerd to launch container.
steps.why_traversal: VPC-native cluster assigns real RFC 1918 VPC IP directly to pod network namespace.

steps.title: NEG Registration
steps.action: NEG controller attaches pod IP directly to Cloud Load Balancer backend service.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates kube-proxy iptables overhead and double-hop routing latencies.

scenarios.label: Secondary Subnet CIDR Exhaustion
scenarios.root_cause: Node pool scaled beyond /20 pod CIDR range; no IP addresses left for new pods.
scenarios.diverted_path: Pods remain stuck in Pending state with FailedCreatePodSandBox error.
scenarios.blast_radius: New pod replicas cannot schedule; autoscaling blocked.
scenarios.recovery: Use GKE multi-pod CIDR feature to attach secondary subnet to node pool.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
